en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, form Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Al Khasshab, from Ali Bin Al Husayn, from Muhammad Bin Abu Hamza, from Abdullah Bin Sinan who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘An owned slave has wealth in his hands, would there be Zakāt upon him?’ Heasws said: ‘No’. I said, ‘Nor upon his master?’ Heasws said: ‘No. It is what he did not give to his master, and it is not for the owned slave’.
